whatIs.title: What is Virtari DS?
whatIs.body: Virtari Design System is a package-based component library built on <1>React</1>, <2>our own headless primitives</2>, and <3>pure vanilla CSS</3> using 2026 standards. Every component is its own publishable npm package under the <4>@virtari</4> scope.
